verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an official MCP integration page, and a probe confirms it. The page states that Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Cowork and any other MCP-compatible client can connect to Braintrust to query production logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring and Topics, and run evals. Missing for 10: setup, authentication and transport details for the MCP server are not in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work as described.
